versions.changelog:
Initial release of agency-carousel-growth-engine, an autonomous AI agent for automating carousel content growth.

- Transforms any website into 6-slide viral TikTok and Instagram carousels.
- Leverages data-driven feedback loops: analyzes analytics, iterates visual and hook strategies, and self-improves over time.
- Uses Playwright for research, Gemini for visual storytelling and coherence, and Upload-Post API for direct daily publishing.
- Stores and evolves best practices (hooks, timing, styles) in a learnings file to enhance future content performance.
